evidence: In game, 2026-11-26 (project owner, while leveling): the Blacksmithing trainer(s) inspected did not offer it at a skill where it would have been listed. This shows only that those trainers don't teach it; it doesn't show that no trainer does, or how it is obtained. Approved data agrees it is not a trainer recipe: One For All 6.3.0 has no fee, teach-list entry, recipe item or source (req=100 rw=true, y=115 g=130 gr=145); cMaNGOS classic-db has no npc_trainer row for it, and in Classic it is taught by item 5577 'Plans: Rough Bronze Bracers' (spell 2761). Whether that item exists in Forever is unknown.
kind: user-reported trainer observation, consistent with approved data
upstream: One For All 6.3.0: no source (would have counted as a trainer recipe under the old inference); learn level rw-excluded, so unknown
scope: acquisition source unknown; not taught by the trainer(s) inspected
